introHtml: Cardboard sticky notes flags offer an eco-friendly alternative to plastic tabs, making them a smart choice for sustainability-minded businesses. These flags are fully recyclable and biodegradable, perfect for companies looking to reduce their environmental footprint. Ideal for marking documents, catalogs, or reports, they can be printed with your logo or message in vibrant colors. Order in bulk for trade shows, office supplies, or promotional kits.
